pedestrian_mesh — DRIVE terrain op

• Data kinds: none → table (an op determined by its arguments alone — it takes no image or data input)

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.pedestrian_mesh(height: 'float' = 1.7, color=None, stride: 'float' = 0.0) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import driveterrain; driveterrain.pedestrian_mesh(height: 'float' = 1.7, color=None, stride: 'float' = 0.0) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("pedestrian_mesh"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

手続き的な歩行者: 脚 2 本(箱)、胴(箱)、頭(回転体)。原点 = 足元中心、+x が前。`stride` [m] で脚を前後に開く。

返り値 `{"V", "F", "color", "label" (7), "dims", "volume"}`(体積は箱の閉形式 + 頭は内接 ≤ 球)。
